note: Where the blog agent delivers posts. Not secret: the intake also needs the key, which lives only in the Anthropic vault (env var BLOG_INTAKE_KEY, sent as a header to the n8n host only). Replace YOUR-N8N-HOST with your n8n host and give each path a random suffix (docs/n8n-door.md).
